scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm --workspace @stickstakes/shared run dev" "npm --workspace @stickstakes/server run dev" "npm --workspace @stickstakes/client run dev"
scripts.dev:phone: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client,tunnel -c gray,cyan,magenta,green "npm --workspace @stickstakes/shared run dev" "npm --workspace @stickstakes/server run dev" "npm --workspace @stickstakes/client run dev" "node scripts/tunnel.mjs"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @stickstakes/server run build && npm --workspace @stickstakes/client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @stickstakes/server run typecheck && npm --workspace @stickstakes/client run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:lobby && npm run test:match && npm run test:combat && npm run test:feel
